channel.title: Onchain Report
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades across the blockchain industry.

item.title: Small Token Balances to ETH: A One-Chain Sweep
item.description: How to convert small token balances into ETH: swap only tokens worth more than approval and gas, and choose native ETH to avoid an extra unwrap.

item.title: Difference between custodial and non-custodial: who holds keys
item.description: Custodial vs non-custodial exchange: what changes? You hold the keys, approve swaps, pay network gas and protect your wallet when trades settle on-chain.

item.title: DEX Swap Route Hops: How Pools Pass Tokens
item.description: What does each hop in a DEX swap route mean? Each hop is one liquidity-pool swap, passing its output token to the next pool until the route reaches your chosen token.

item.title: US gets court approval to seize $1.2B in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department has court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack funds, while efforts to trace and recover the rest continue.

item.title: MEV protection vs slippage tolerance: How attacks use your limit
item.description: MEV protection vs slippage tolerance: neither works alone. Slippage caps sandwich losses; private routing hides your swap, while pair depth guides the trade-off.

item.title: Cancelling a DEX Limit Order: Steps and Outcomes
item.description: To cancel a limit order on a DEX, open active orders, select the order and confirm cancellation. Then check its status and any amount already filled.

item.title: What Is a Limit Order on KyberSwap? Choosing the Right Trade
item.description: What is a limit order on KyberSwap? It waits for your chosen price and may never fill; choose a regular swap when you need the trade done now.

item.title: US gets court approval over $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: US authorities have court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance, as efforts to track and recover the funds continue.

item.title: US authorizes seizure of $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds
item.description: US officials have court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, part of a wider freeze as investigators trace the rest.

item.title: US wins court approval to seize $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department says courts have authorized action against more than $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, as investigators and crypto firms keep tracing the rest.

item.title: US gets court approval to seize $1.2bn from Binance hack
item.description: The Justice Department says it has court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance, as recovery work continues.

item.title: Injective’s Veyra upgrade goes to vote ahead of Nov. 24 target
item.description: Injective's IIP-717 vote would move the chain to v1.21.0 on Nov. 24 and add cross-chain asset routes and institutional trading tools if stakers approve it.

item.title: Across restores its site after domain hijack
item.description: Across says it has recovered its domain and restored service after a phishing takeover, as it investigates the attack and promises to make affected users whole.

item.title: Coinbase National Trust charter takes effect under OCC oversight
item.description: Coinbase National Trust Company’s OCC charter took effect Nov. 6, putting its custody work under federal oversight while leaving it outside full-service banking.

item.title: Coinbase wins final OCC approval for national trust charter
item.description: The OCC has made Coinbase’s national trust charter effective, putting its planned institutional crypto custody business under a federal framework.

item.title: U.S. order targets MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows
item.description: A FinCEN order will bar U.S. institutions from sending funds to or from MEXC after Treasury alleged at least $16 billion in illicit flows over five years.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview helped enable $6.34bn hack
item.description: Binance says a fake job interview helped hackers reach its wallet systems before $6.34bn in crypto was taken, exposing a months-long breach of exchange security.

item.title: FBI links $6 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korea’s TraderTraitor group stole more than $6 billion from Binance and urges crypto services to block wallets as laundering moves to ether.

item.title: FBI ties $6 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance and is urging crypto firms to block linked wallets as the funds move into Ether for laundering.

item.title: FBI links $6B Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6 billion from Binance and urges crypto services to block wallets used to move the funds after the record-setting theft.
